findings.finding: Storefront-valid owner and costCenter values can be invalid in the AI/product contract because validation rules are manually duplicated and have drifted.
findings.recommendedAction: Establish a canonical contract or generated compatibility layer and add a scored schema-conformance control proving every storefront-valid order is downstream-valid.

findings.finding: The current proof encodes a human-approval boundary and validates an importable Backstage template, but does not execute a deployed Backstage runtime, real publish:github:pull-request action, human approval/merge event, or GitOps handoff.
findings.recommendedAction: Use precise evidence language now and create a separate Backstage runtime smoke gate before live cloud validation.

findings.finding: Exact repository SHAs are pinned but third-party execution dependencies remain partly mutable: GitHub Action tags, runner images, Python package installs, semver package tags, and downloaded Kind/kubectl/Helm binaries without checksum verification.
findings.recommendedAction: Pin actions and dependencies immutably where practical, verify downloaded tools, and capture execution dependency identities in evidence.

findings.finding: The TFE experiment says scores must come from observed evidence, but the example results pre-score Crossplane and TFE while several evidence fields are placeholders. The test/scorer accepts them.
findings.recommendedAction: Make unobserved metrics null/unscored or reject placeholder evidence; run the residual TFE comparison from measured scenarios only.

findings.finding: The coordinating repository still freezes the pre-storefront baseline even though run 31210928432 is the first successful Backstage-inclusive 1.34/1.35/1.36 100/100 proof.
findings.recommendedAction: Create a new immutable Backstage-inclusive baseline without overwriting the historical v1 baseline.

findings.finding: networkCidr, subnetCidr, and deletionPolicy remain writable on the stable product API even though the consumer experience treats network implementation and lifecycle defaults as platform-owned concerns.
findings.recommendedAction: Review whether these fields belong behind profile/IPAM/lifecycle policy before declaring the product contract durable beyond the POC.

findings.finding: CIDR schema checks allow invalid octets and do not verify subnet containment within the network, allowing live-provider failures to occur after admission.
findings.recommendedAction: Use semantically correct CIDR validation and enforce subnet containment before the live AWS gate.

findings.finding: The storefront lock file treats the integration harness and architecture baseline as upstreams even though integration consumes the storefront, creating a conceptual dependency cycle and stale references.
findings.recommendedAction: Separate runtime/build upstreams from historical evidence/baseline references and keep the dependency graph acyclic.

findings.finding: AI prompts/tool-boundary material exists in the product repository while the dedicated composite-AI repository is defined as the owner of agent contracts and evaluations.
findings.recommendedAction: Keep only the product-facing interface contract in the product repo or explicitly define which artifacts are normative to prevent drift.

findings.finding: The Backstage status/evidence tracking experience is documented as a target read model but is not implemented or validated in a running Backstage instance.
findings.recommendedAction: Add a read-only status/evidence adapter in the Backstage runtime smoke gate without adding infrastructure execution authority.

conclusion.requiredNextGate: Portfolio contract and reproducibility correction gate
conclusion.statement: The architecture and credential-free evidence support continuation and the existing TFE-optional conclusion, but contract consistency, comparison neutrality, evidence semantics, and supply-chain reproducibility should be corrected before the live AWS gate.
